content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH approach is simple: we build you a digital commerce stack that you own outright. This is not a workaround or a hack. It's base-layer infrastructure that gives you the same power as established e-commerce platforms, but with full sovereignty. You're not renting someone else's platform or depending on their infrastructure. You're building your own store, with your own data, on your own terms. And because we use free, open-source tools, you're not locked into any subscriptions or recurring fees. Once your stack is deployed, it's yours forever, with no ongoing costs.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started with COREMERCH, you'll need a few key components. First, you'll need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to serve your store's frontend. Then, you'll need a backend logic provider like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle your store's functionality. For order storage, you can use Supabase or Google Sheets, and for file delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 are excellent options. The final piece of the puzzle is NOWPayments, our automatic crypto payment processing solution. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with your chosen hosting and backend logic providers, and it supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low 0.5% fee. With these components in place, you're ready to deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The first step in deploying your COREMERCH stack is setting up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves configuring NOWPayments to receive payments in your preferred cryptocurrency, such as USDT on the Tron or Solana network, which offer fast settlement and low transaction fees. You'll also need to set up your file delivery system, whether it's Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This is where your digital products will be stored, and customers will receive instant access after making a successful payment. By integrating NOWPayments with your chosen delivery system, you create a seamless, automated process where customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
COREMERCH gives you the power to build your own digital commerce empire, free from platform limitations.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This is where the power of COREMERCH really shines. When a customer purchases your product, NOWPayments automatically verifies the crypto payment on-chain, triggering your backend logic to deliver the product files instantly. There's no manual intervention required, and no waiting for third-party platforms to process payments or release funds. Your customers get their purchases immediately, and you receive the payment directly in your crypto wallet, without any intermediaries.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your COREMERCH stack up and running, you can focus on scaling your digital commerce business. The beauty of this infrastructure is its flexibility and scalability. You can add more products, optimize your store's performance, and expand your customer base without worrying about platform limitations or subscription fees. As your business grows, you can explore additional features like email marketing, analytics, and customer relationship management, all integrated seamlessly into your COREMERCH stack. And because you own the infrastructure, you have complete control over your data, your customers' experience, and your business's growth trajectory.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

COREMERCH is not just another e-commerce platform or payment gateway. It's a complete sovereign commerce infrastructure solution, designed to empower digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or unreliable. With COREMERCH, you get the tools and support to build your own digital store, process crypto payments, and deliver products instantly, all while maintaining full ownership and control. It's the ultimate solution for creators who want to take control of their commerce destiny, free from the constraints of centralized platforms and their limitations.
With COREMERCH, you own your store, your data, and your customers' experience.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're ready to take the next step, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is your all-in-one solution. It includes all six blueprints and seven templates, giving you everything you need to deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack. With the Complete Builder Kit, you can build your store, process crypto payments, and deliver digital products with full control and ownership. It's time to break free from platform limitations and take charge of your digital commerce future.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages.
2. Set up your backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script.
3. Configure NOWPayments to receive crypto payments in your preferred currency.
4. Integrate your file delivery system: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
5. Test your payment and delivery pipeline: Make a test purchase and ensure instant product delivery.
6. Go live: Launch your store and start processing real transactions.
7. Scale your business: Add more products, optimize performance, and expand your customer base.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I know which stack is right for me?

The choice of stack depends on your specific needs and technical preferences. Stack 01, deployed with GitHub Pages and Apps Script, is a great starting point for those new to cloud infrastructure. Stack 02, with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, offers more advanced features and scalability. The Sovereign Blueprint provides detailed documentation for all stacks, allowing you to make an informed decision based on your requirements.
Can I use my own domain name with COREMERCH?

Absolutely! COREMERCH is designed to work seamlessly with custom domain names. You can easily connect your domain to your chosen hosting platform, ensuring a professional and branded online presence for your digital store. This is a crucial step in building a recognizable and trusted brand for your digital commerce business.
How do I add more products to my store?

Adding products to your COREMERCH store is straightforward. You can either manually add product details to your chosen order storage system (Supabase or Google Sheets) or use automated scripts to import product data from a CSV file or another source. COREMERCH provides detailed documentation and support to guide you through this process, ensuring a smooth and efficient product management experience.
What happens if I need support after the initial 30-day period?

COREMERCH offers a comprehensive support system to ensure your success. After the initial 30-day support period, you can access our extensive documentation, community forums, and support tickets for ongoing assistance. We also provide optional paid support plans for creators who require more hands-on guidance and assistance with their COREMERCH stacks.
How can I ensure my customers' data is secure?

COREMERCH prioritizes data security and privacy. By using cloud infrastructure from providers like Cloudflare and Google, you benefit from their robust security measures, including encryption, access controls, and data protection policies. Additionally, COREMERCH provides guidance on best practices for securing your store, such as implementing SSL certificates and protecting customer data.
